expert_diagnosis: Future Retail suffered a compounding insolvency crisis rooted in overleveraged retail structure, COVID demand disruption, and a failed strategic rescue transaction. The only viable exit (Reliance sale) was blocked by a combination of Amazon legal intervention and secured creditor resistance, leaving the company with no restructuring pathway and an active IBC petition. Root causes were: debt solvency pressure, liquidity crisis, failed strategic rescue, legal and governance constraint, creditor misalignment, COVID disruption shock, and overleveraged retail structure.
expert_first_action: Seek immediate creditor standstill via court-supervised restructuring under IBC, separate the Amazon legal dispute from the core survival plan, engage secured creditors to develop a fallback restructuring, and preserve any remaining operational liquidity while preparing insolvency contingency.
actual_decision: Bank of India pursued IBC petition before NCLT Mumbai. Company did not achieve creditor consensus or implement alternative restructuring before admission.
harmful_actions: Over-reliance on single strategic rescue transaction (Reliance deal) without fallback
Failure to achieve secured creditor alignment before vote
Allowing legal dispute to block the only available restructuring pathway
No alternative restructuring plan developed before petition filing
beneficial_actions: Early warning in 2020 that liquidation risk existed if Reliance deal failed
Creditors exercised IBC rights to protect dues
citation: NCLT Mumbai, Company Petition (IB)-527(MB)/2022 under Section 7 IBC; IBBI case records L51909MH2007PLC268269; Bank of India petition — default recorded ₹856.10 crore as of 31 December 2021, broader dues ₹5,322.32 crore as of 31 March 2022
actual_outcome: NCLT Mumbai admitted insolvency on 20 July 2022, Company Petition (IB)-527(MB)/2022 under Section 7 IBC. Reliance transaction did not proceed. CIRP commenced. Later reports indicate liquidation ordered after no resolution plan was approved.
documented_root_causes: Debt solvency pressure — ₹5,322.32 crore in bank dues unpayable
Liquidity crisis — unable to service obligations
Failed strategic rescue transaction — Reliance deal blocked
Legal and governance constraint — Amazon dispute entangled asset sale
Creditor misalignment — secured creditors voted against scheme
COVID and retail disruption shock — demand and revenue impaired
Overleveraged retail structure — insufficient buffer for external shock
final_business_state: Admitted to CIRP under IBC July 2022. No resolution plan approved. Liquidation ordered.
